g.text: Methodology: J-Curve tracks Cumulative Net Cash Flow (Gross Benefits minus Capex and Opex) from Year 0 to Year 5 across all 14 candidate initiatives. H1 near-term cash generation eliminates portfolio deficit by Month 14.5, self-funding H3 real options exploration. Source: totalenergies_ai_portfolio_model.xlsx.
